title: Chapter 617
paragraphs: Chapter 617
Episode 159. The Great War of the Two Kings (4)
Kaio looked at Jin with cold eyes for a while, without answering.
"When our turn comes in the tournament, as a brother. I'll teach you a lesson that you'll engrave in your bones, Jin."
"You speak of brotherhood with such young eyes. Looking back, it seemed like the Twelve Kings Brother has not favored me from the beginning."
"Jin brother!"
"What are you talking about, it's too much! How can you see the Twelve Kings Brother...!"
Some of the Myungwangs who had been watching exclaimed in surprise.
Even Garmund was surprised, his eyes wide open.

"Does my word seem wrong, brothers? When I received Sigmund from Tushin Brother, I don't remember receiving congratulations from the Twelve Kings Brother. Moreover, now he is openly belittling my victory in front of everyone."
There were a few people who did not congratulate at the time, but Jin deliberately said as if only Kaio did so.
"That's because the Twelve Kings Brother was angry with the Eight Kings Brother..."

"If he was really only angry with the Eight Kings Brother, the Twelve Kings Brother should not have mentioned diapers. It's a word that clearly reveals how the Twelve Kings Brother has thought of me. Moreover, the Twelve Kings Brother definitely fought with sincerity. Then why is the Twelve Kings Brother saying as if I can't beat him?"
The Myungwangs couldn't immediately refute Jin's words. Jin quickly continued his words so the brothers couldn't strike back.
"Also, the reason why the Twelve Kings Brother just stepped up and caused a disturbance had nothing to do with my honor."
"Why do you think so?"
"The Twelve Kings Brother expressed anger because he suspected that the Eight Kings Brother intentionally lost to me. But what was the word he said right after?"
Jin looked around the brothers once.

"Are you still the Two Kings of the glorious Myungwang clan? That was it. If I were the Twelve Kings Brother, I would have spoken differently. Fighting like that is an insult to Brother Jin. Shouldn't the priority be to take care of the brother who has never participated in an intentional defeat, not the honor of the Two Kings?"
Silence flowed.
Although Jin intentionally spoke more harshly, there was nothing wrong.
To hammer in the mood, Jin locked eyes with Kaio again.

"Twelve Kings Brother. I want to say this one last time. Don't tarnish the honor of the glorious Myungwang clan. Just now, you insulted the Eight Kings Brother and me based on mere speculation, and you attacked your brother. The way we, as brothers, have been with each other is far from this. It's disappointing."

"Jin brother, stop now. Both the Eight Kings Brother and the Twelve Kings Brother have just made a mistake. It's too much to conclude that the Twelve Kings Brother has disliked Jin brother from the beginning."
At Baltirock's words, Jin bowed his head.

"I just tried to guess the psychology of the Twelve Kings Brother like the Twelve Kings Brother did, One-Two Kings Brother. And I'm rarely wrong. Let's see during our tournament, Twelve Kings Brother."
As soon as Jin turned around and left the main hall, Tantel quickly chased after him, throwing himself to the surface.
"Jin brother! What are you trying to do like this? Have you already forgotten the story I told you?"
"I did it on purpose."
"What?"
"There was a need to stimulate the brothers' will to win. Seeing the Eight Kings Brother lose to me, I thought that this was needed at least once from the beginning."
"Huh, explain in detail."
"Okay, just keep it to yourself, Tantel Brother. Promise on the honor of Tushin Brother and all brothers."
The atmosphere of Lafrarosa changed after that day.
First, the gem liquor gambling disappeared.
In fact, gem liquor gambling is nothing more than everyone's pleasure, with no victims.
Both the winner and the loser just divide up and drink the gem liquor used for gambling, laughing and chatting, that's all.
Everyone just wants to have a good time. Such a pleasure is only possible when Jin comes and makes time flow in Lafrarosa.
With the disappearance of gem liquor gambling, naturally, the laughter of the Myungwang clan participating in the Two Kings Tournament disappeared.
Even if they flaunt their fighting spirit to each other and push each other to the point of death, the Two Kings Tournament fundamentally pursues a competition of goodwill.
It was not such an atmosphere now.
Like before the peaceful times of Tushin's side, invisible factions were formed.
There was a side that had to admit that Jin had already been designated as the successor of Tushin in the past, and a side that said that it was not enough just by that.

The former stands by the position that as a brother who simply loves Jin, unconditional support is required, while the latter raised the argument that the situation has now changed and rigorous scrutiny is needed.
"If we continue to be trapped, it doesn't matter, but if we can get out, the competition for Tushin Brother's successor must be clear."

"Right, it's a good thing for Jin Brother too. If the successor of Tushin is not someone who everyone can undoubtedly recognize, our Myungwang clan will eventually weaken. In that case, we can't properly help Jin Brother when we get out."
"Brothers, you're talking nonsense! Jin Brother is the person chosen directly by Tushin Brother. Are you doubting Tushin Brother's judgement?"
"No. Back then, we were in a situation where there was no hope of getting out by grace. As Tushin Brother, of course, Jin Brother had to be chosen."
"Nonsense!"

"If not, why would Tushin Brother have left as it is when the Twelve Kings Brother stepped forward in the 7th tournament? It would have been because it's no longer right to force Jin Brother like the Eight Kings Brother. If Tushin Brother had stepped forward himself, things could have gotten strange."
"That's disrespectful to Tushin Brother. And, since when has the Two Kings Tournament become a competition to decide the successor of Tushin Brother?"
"It has always been implicit. The ultimate winner of the Two Kings Tournament has mostly become the next Tushin."

"Damn it, brothers! To my eyes, it just looks like a meaningless fight. Are you saying that our love for each other only amounts to this? You want to test Jin Brother, who has already been chosen as the successor, again? It's shameful to look at Jin Brother, arguing and dividing sides for such a reason!"
"The elbow always bends inward. There must be brothers who think of Jin Brother as a rolling stone, right? Ungrateful...!"
"Shaku Brother, don't say that. No one thinks that way!"

"I'm not sure. To be honest, I think the Twelve Kings Brother sees Jin Brother like that. When Jin Brother lost two in a row this time, was I the only one who saw the Twelve Kings Brother scoffing as if it was ridiculous?"
Two consecutive losses.
In the 12th tournament, Jin lost to Palem, and in the 17th tournament, he lost to Dalfir.
Unlike when he won against Teto and Garmund, he was severely defeated.

"Also, it felt pretty emotional when the Three-Two Kings Brother and the Six-Two Kings Brother faced Jin Brother. They didn't finish it in one go even when they had the upper hand. Could they do that if they genuinely cared for Jin Brother? And both Two Kings Brothers are very close to the Twelve Kings Brother."
"All of us in the Myungwang clan are close, you're speculating again!"

"Even if the two Two Kings Brothers deliberately tormented Jin Brother, it would have been to provide enlightenment as a Two King. And, no matter what the reason, Jin Brother lost. It means he has moved further away from the qualifications to become Tushin Brother's successor."
"Are you done talking, Mouka Brother? Fortunately, we are included in the tournament of the regular fighters today. Shall we say the opinion of the winner is right?"
"Huh, is that how you're going to play it? I have no intention of backing down. Don't regret it!"
The conflict among the Myungwang clan was deepening day by day. It was hard to believe these were the same people who had been living so peacefully and ideally just a little while ago
Those who were trying to stay neutral and observe felt like they were standing on thin ice every day.
Although it has not collapsed yet, it's a situation where it would not be surprising if everyone exploded at any opportunity.
"My goodness... I thought we wouldn't have such childish conflicts in our time. Aren't they ashamed in front of our deceased brothers? How can this happen?"

Beliz, who was watching the brothers from a distance, touched her forehead. She had been one of the first to welcome and cherish Jin, but now she maintained neutrality, fearing the escalation of conflict.
"Brother O2, has the Brother of Tushin said anything different?"
Beliz asked Boras, who was sitting next to her.
Boras shrugged his shoulders and nodded.
"I don't know if they're just sick of it all, or if they have something in mind. They only play around except during the Grand Tournament."
"It's driving me crazy. If things go as they are, it seems a huge fuss will arise when Brother Jin meets the Twelfth Brother...."
The 22nd Grand Tournament, the fight between Jin and Kaio, was just around the corner.
Jin was still recovering from the injuries he sustained from his previous defeat, while Kaio was ready to go, having fought even more tournaments.
"...It seems that the Twelfth Brother has no intention of giving a break. He's holding a grudge."
The conflict was a powder keg, and their Grand Tournament was a spark.
All the members of the Myeongwang clan predicted Kaio's overwhelming victory, and they were aware that the rift between factions would deepen after that.
One of them should step back and stop this conflict, but neither Jin nor Kaio seemed willing to apologize to each other.
"Hah, surely the Twelfth Brother wouldn't kill Brother Jin?"
"Would they do such a crazy thing! They're just angry. Why is the Seventh Brother also like this? Don't you trust the Twelfth Brother? There's no way brothers would kill each other over this."
"Damn, I don't know. The way they acted that day, it was like watching the Twelfth Brother back when he was crazy."
When Kaio was crazy.
Beliz and Boras remembered exactly what Kaio was like during that period.
Kaio was ready to cross the line at any time.
As everyone was worried and expecting,
Time didn't solve anything and reached the day of the tournament between Jin and Kaio.
On the top of the main hall, all the members of the Myeongwang clan gathered and held their breath, looking at Jin and Kaio.
Half of them, as always, had an inscrutable face.
"We finally meet, Twelfth Brother."
At Jin's words, Kaio nodded his head. Kaio only replied in a cold voice.
"If you feel like you're going to die, scream for help. If not, there might be an accident."
